evidence.quote: We verified the calibration against the June reference plates

observations.why: Verification against a fixed external standard enacts deference to a prior authority — the reference plates arbitrate correctness, not the speaker's say-so.
Labelled-field format enacts a reporting structure that defers to a standardized template — the field label carries institutional authority over the content's form.
Restating verification against a fixed reference standard enacts deference to that external authority as the arbiter of calibration correctness.
